Sodium (7R)-7-[2-(1H-tetrazol-1-yl)acetamido]-3-(1,3,4-thiadiazol-2- ylthiomethyl)-3-cephem-4-carboxylate. Натрий Цефтезол C13H11N8NaO4S3 = 462.5. CAS — 26973-24-0 (ceftezole); 41136-22-5 (ceftezole sodium). ATC — J01DB12. ATC Vet — QJ01DB12. Pharmacopoeias. In Chin. Profile Ceftezole is a cephalosporin antibacterial with properties similar to those of cefalotin (p.219). It is given as the sodium salt but doses are expressed in terms of the base; 1.05 g of ceftezole so- dium is equivalent to about 1 g of ceftezole. The usual dose is 2 to 4 g daily by intramuscular injection in 2 or 3 divided doses. Sodium content. Each g of ceftezole sodium contains about 2.16 mmol of sodium.
